Timestamp.description: Timestamp for the specific message (ISO 8601 format).

URL.description: The URL of the page visited.

VisitTime.description: The time the user landed on the page (ISO 8601 format).

FullPageHTML.description: The complete HTML content of the page scrape (large string).

RawCustomerReviewInput.title: RawCustomerReviewInput
RawCustomerReviewInput.description: The raw payload sent from the user's client-side widget to the backend processing pipeline for review submission.

ReviewSubmissionTimestamp.description: The moment the user submitted the review/ended the chat (ISO 8601 format).

UserMetadata.description: Customer metadata relevant for subscription status and location.

SubscriptionLevel.description: The customer's current known subscription level (e.g., 'Free', 'Premium', 'Pro').

Geolocation.description: User's location data at the time of submission.

RawChatHistory.description: The unprocessed, chronological conversation history from the chatbot.

RawWebHistory.description: Structured list of recent web page visits, including full HTML scrapes.

ChatbotRequest.title: ChatbotRequest
ChatbotRequest.description: The payload sent from the client-side widget to the chat endpoint for real-time chatbot interaction.

RawChatHistory.description: The unprocessed, chronological conversation history from the chatbot.

RawWebHistory.description: Optional: Structured list of recent web page visits, including full HTML scrapes. Providing this allows the chatbot to give context-aware responses based on pages the user has visited.
